name: Penny Pincher
author: tesu
punchline: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices
description:
Plugin for simplifying "pennying" (undercutting current lowest offer by 1).

The usual workflow for this is the following:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Take a mental note of what the current lowest offer is
4. Subtract one from it
5. Close the current listings window
6. Update your item's price with the number you noted
7. Confirm your new price

This plugin eliminates the mental notekeeping steps in the middle by automatically copying the number you want onto your clipboard when you open the current listings window.

Therefore, your new workflow becomes this:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Close the current listings window
4. Paste the undercut value in
5. Confirm your new price

This both speeds up the process and reduces room for error from typos.

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.

name: ActionTimeline
author: Tischel
punchline: Show your actions in real-time.
description: Configurable timeline display of all the actions you use.

name: Who's Talking
author: ash
punchline: See Discord voice activity indicators directly on your party list.
description:
Once installed, join a Discord voice channel and an XIV party, and have people put their character names in their Discord nicknames (or configure things manually in the plugin settings). You should get colourful outlines around the job icons on the party list: green for talking, blue for muted, red for deafened, and yellow for unknown name.

Note that you'll get a permission prompt mentioning "StreamKit Overlay" – this is expected.

Some icons by Google, Apache 2.0.

name: DragoonMayCry
author: Felscream
punchline: A plugin that ranks your performance based on your fundamentals in combat
description: A plugin that tries to add flavour to combat. You score by dealing damage and keeping your GCD rolling, and lose points if you are not greeding correctly. Now with dynamic BGM.

name: Eventy
author: Infi
punchline: Never forget a seasonal event ever again
description:
Simple but useful calender
- Current events displayed within a server bar entry for quick viewing
- Browse through current, upcoming and previously held events
- Special dates for Liveletters and other important occasions are highlighted

name: OfDungeonsDeep
author: NotNite, MidoriKami, maintained by Khayle
punchline: Comprehensive monster dex for DeepDungeons
description:
Based loosely on DeepDungeonDex (by Strati), OfDungeonsDeep is an all-in-one tool for Deep Dungeon floor and mob information.
Data sourced with permission from https://www.ddcompendium.com/.

name: HUD Manager
author: nebel (prev. ascclemens, Necoji)
punchline: Take total control over your HUD.
description:
- Save infinite HUD layouts
- Edit your HUD with precision
- Automatically swap between HUD layouts based on conditions
- Make child layouts that only affect desired HUD elements
- Change visibility of job gauges
- Export and import layouts from text

name: LazyGatherer
author: Hiroa
punchline: Optimize your GP.
description: Display the optimal rotation for maximum yield with your current GP.

name: Death Roll Helper
author: Infi, Caitlyn
punchline: Plugin to help with a number of dice games. Also offers games like Tic-Tac-Toe, Minesweeper and Bahamood.
description:
## Modes
### Venue:
- Concise display of all concurrent players in a list-based format
- Supports multiple sorting types (min, max, nearest to)
- Highlight numbers based on regex matching

### DeathRoll:
- Supports multiple players
- Automatic checks to prevent number skipping

### Tournament (1v1 DeathRoll):
- Automatic bracket generation with byes to fill uneven
- Forfeit functionality if a player needs to leave

### Blackjack:
- Automatic reward calculation based on common rules
- Simplistic, or visual view of cards in play
- Automatic or manual player-based draw for cards

### Extra Features:
- Block or prevent players from partaking in any game
- Accept only /random or /dice commands

## Games
### Tic-Tac-Toe
- Play against your friends, or AI
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5

### Minesweeper
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 8x8, 9x9, 16x16, 18x30
- Custom Games (planned)

More features are planned, following user feedback.

name: Currency Tracker
author: AtmoOmen
punchline: Track all your currencies!
description:
Track changes of currencies with Time, Location and Note(Source)!

Also provide something like queries, exporting, adding custom currencies tracker and viewing visualized data.

name: Mini
author: NightmareXIV
punchline: Adds a button and a command to minimize your game into taskbar
description: Additionally can minimize game to tray or create game's tray icon

name: Better Targeting System
author: Lynesth, maintained by Khayle
punchline: A more intelligent targeting system for the game.
description: A more intelligent targeting system for the game which also includes new keybinds.

name: CollectableCalculator
author: Liza Carvelli
punchline: Shows how many scrips and items you would receive if you turn in your current inventory.
description: Shows how many scrips and items you would receive if you turn in your current inventory.

name: Orbwalker
author: kawaii, NightmareXIV
punchline: S P A C E G L I D I N G
description: Locks player movement while casting and allows for maximum caster uptime during the course of a fight.

name: Gauge-O-Matic
author: ItsBexy
punchline: Enhance and customize job gauges.
description: Gauge-O-Matic allows you to customize your job gauges by adding extra counters, bars, and indicators in a variety of styles

name: Sound Filter
author: Cytraen, Anna
punchline: Filter any game sound.
description:
Filters any sound or set of sounds from the game.

- Remove a battle sound effect you don't like
- Remove specific emote sounds
- Remove specific background music

Icons: filter by Kirby Wu from the Noun Project
and Sound by Gregor Cresnar from the Noun Project

name: Compass
author: Chivalrik
punchline: Monodimensional compass for your adventures.
description:
Check-out the repository for steps on how to report missing/wrong filter
and hiding options. Have a look at the FAQ tab in the config window
after install for common caveats.

name: Currency Spender
author: Blackcatz1911
punchline: Discover how to use all the in-game currencies.
description: Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.

name: OwO
author: goat, modded by Franz
punchline: owo for your chat
description: This plugin uwu's your chat.

name: Who Did That?
author: spide-r
punchline: Actively logs healing, cleanses, buffs, and more. Finally figure out who rescued you.
description:
This plugin can track the following actions:
- Rescues
- Healing actions
- Status/Buff Application
- Cleanses
- Heals
- Mitigation
- Provoke
- Shirk

These will be logged in your chat when they are used on your character.

name: NecroLens
author: jukka
punchline: A true Necromancer always know the DeepDungeon ... everyone else just uses a high tech!
description: DeepDungeon Helper. Radar for Mobs, Aggro, Sight and everything else.

name: BetterFriendList
author: Loody
punchline: SE friend list sucks.
description:
Friend list but with better sorting, can search by name, refresh with a button, color names..
Right click for context menu.

name: ChatAlerts
author: Caraxi & Ottermandias
punchline: Play sounds and highlight text based on defined filters.
description: Play sounds and highlight text based on defined filters.

name: Mimicry Helper
author: RedMage1993
punchline: Automatically mimic the role you're looking for.
description: Use /mimic to open up the menu and click on a role to mimic. You may also use d, h, or t in the command, e.g. /mimic d.

name: ExtraChat
author: Anna
punchline: Cross-data-centre linkshells with unlimited members.
description:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game.

name: DelvCD
author: Tischel
punchline: Customizable UI elements to track cooldowns, status and more.
description: DelvCD provides highly customizable UI elements that can be used to track cooldows, status and more with configurable conditions.

name: The Great Separator
author: Anna
punchline: Add separators to various numbers.
description:
Add separators to various numbers.

- Damage/healing numbers (not DoTs or other players' numbers)
- Party list HP
- Ability costs on hotbars
- Ability costs in tooltips

name: XIVDeck
author: KazWolfe
punchline: Turn your Elgato Stream Deck into a hotbar!
description:
This plugin allows players to use an Elgato Stream Deck as a virtual utility hot bar. Actions are called directly, meaning there is no need to set up awkward keybinds, custom macros, or any other settings.

Note that the XIVDeck Stream Deck plugin must also be installed for this plugin to be useful. You can download the Stream Deck plugin from the linked GitHub repository, under the "Releases" section.

Please report all problems to KazWolfe#2896 in the Dalamud Support server or by opening an Issue on GitHub.

name: FlyTextFilter
author: Aireil
punchline: Filter fly texts and pop-ups texts based on multiple criteria and allow the adjustment of their positions.
description: Filter fly texts and pop-ups texts based on multiple criteria and allow the adjustment of their positions.

name: WTSync
author: Khloe Leclair, BoxuChan
punchline: View a list of all the Wondrous Tails duties shared by your party.
description: WTSync keeps uses an external server to keep track of the duties in your Wondrous Tails book. When you're in a party, and other players in the party are also using WTSync, you can open a UI to see which duties everyone needs at once in one convenient list.

name: OpenerCreator
author: Infi, herulume, sevii
punchline: Create, save, and practice your openers.
description: Create your opener and practice with a striking dummy. Provides basic analysis.

name: NOTED
author: Tischel
punchline: Duty-specific notes!
description:
Lets you create notes that are linked to specific duties (they will only show during those duties).
You can also tie notes to certain jobs so they only appear when on the right job.

name: MP Tick Bar
author: Marconsou
punchline: Visually tracks MP regeneration ticks (Black Mage only).
description:
-Fast Fire III marker on the bar.
-Autostarts the bar before combat starts.
-Countdown with time offset.
-Compatible with FFXIV Material UI.

name: Waymark Studio
author: sourpuh
punchline: The Ultimate FFXIV Waymark Plugin
description: A total replacement for the in-game waymark editor and Waymark Preset plugin. It provides a suite of tools to make placing and loading waymark presets simple, fast, and accurate.

name: FATE Helper
author: Teechep Bird
punchline: Makes FATEs suck slightly less, guaranteed! Disclaimer: atma drop rates will continue to suck.
description: Displays a list of all FATEs in the current area with: time remaining, percent completed, and bonus marker. Clicking on FATE name will flag it and teleport you, if flying isn't faster. Works with Eureka and Occult FATEs, and Bozja skirmishes.

name: Waitingway
author: Asriel
punchline: Set out for Dawntrail and make your queues a breeze. Waitingway provides crowdsourced FFXIV login queue times, now with Discord queue notification features.
description:
Contributes and utilizes crowdsourced login, duty, and roulette queue information for the benefit of everyone.

Current features include queue time estimates and notifications via Discord, so you can know when you make it into the game, as well as anonymously collecting and reporting statistics about your queue times to crowdsource information about FFXIV server load and activity. Join our Discord for more information!

Discord URL: https://waiting.camora.dev/discord

name: vfallguy
author: veyn, croizat
punchline: Get that achievement!
description: Bot that does fall guys event automatically.

name: XIVWindowResizer
author: AlexCSDev
punchline: Game window resizing plugin. Ever wanted to take 8K screenshots on 144p screen? Now you can.
description:
Set your game window to arbitrary size not limited by your display resolution. Mostly useful for taking high-resolution screenshots without going fullscreen and using DSR/FSR.
Requires borderless or windowed mode.

name: DSR Toolbox
author: NightmareXIV
punchline: A helper plugin for Dragonsong's Reprise (Ultimate).
description:
Current functions:
Resolve eyes position
Wroth flames automarker (whole group and personal)
Tether to your chain partner

name: MultiHit
author: Bluefissure
punchline: Split flytext into multiple flytext.
description: Papa asked me for this so here it is.

name: Say What?
author: PunishedPineapple
punchline: Persistent NPC Flavor Text
description: Prints NPC speech bubbles to the chat log. Please check the plugin settings and your chat log filters to make sure that they are compatible with each other.

name: Beachcomber
author: Mienna
punchline: Determines the most profitable agenda for your Island Sanctuary workshop each cycle
description:
This solver examines your Island Sanctuary data (including your Isleventory!) to provide recommendations to maximize your Seafarer's Cowrie earnings.

Made in collaboration with the Overseas Casuals.

name: Burnt Toast
author: X'pahtalo (originally Anna)
punchline: Hides toast notifications you don't want to see.
description: Hides toast notifications you don't want to see.

name: Which Mount
author: Megurt
punchline: Shows what mount another player is using. Includes a mount database, chat links, and trial totem tracking.
description:
Shows information about mounts other players are using.

Features:
- 'Find Mount' in a player's context menu: shows their mount and how to get it.
- Mount name and unlock status in the target tooltip.
- Mount database with search, expansion filter and acquisition info.
- Trial mount tracks with totem counts (inventory, saddlebag, retainers).
- Chat links: click a mount or totem icon to link it in chat, jump back from any link via 'Open in WhichMount'.

name: NoTypeSay
author: salanth357
punchline: Tired of typing snae ling? Click instead!
description:
Adds a button on the duty list for /say quests like quest items and emotes have!
Compatible with all languages and controllers.

name: Malmstone Calculator
author: pinapelz
punchline: Keep tabs on how much more PVP you have to play before unlocking your next Series Malmstone reward!
description:
Calculates the number of wins/losses needed in different modes of PVP before achieving your target Series Level
- Receive post-match notifications about progress towards next Series Level
- Track and display Series Level above 30
- Calculate Frontline losing streak bonus rewards

Use /pmalm to get started

name: Ultrawide Cutscenes
author: goat, Maple
punchline: Remove letterboxing from cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
description:
This plugin removes the "letterboxing" bars when watching cutscenes on ultrawide monitors.
Beware! You may see things that you are not supposed to be seeing, such as upcoming NPCs popping in or T-posing.

Thanks to aers for finding this.

name: wahventory
author: wah
punchline: Advanced inventory management with safety filters and auto-discard
description: Advanced inventory management with safety filters and auto-discard

name: CrossUp
author: ItsBexy
punchline: Customize the Cross Hotbar!
description:
This plugin provides various customizations for the look and feel of the Cross Hotbar.

-Split up the left/right hotbars
-Display Expanded Hold Controls Separately
-Customize colors and element positions
-Greater control over which sets your extra bars are mapped to

name: Acquisition Date
author: Glyceri
punchline: Shows the date when you acquired something.
description:
Shows the date when you acquired:
- Achievements
- Quests
- Duties
- Levels
- Fish
- Sightseeing Log Entries
- Glasses
- Minions
- Mounts
- Orchestrion Rolls
- Fashion Accessories
And More!

name: Kingdom Hearts UI Bars
author: Gotest
punchline: HP bar, MP bar, EXP bar, oh my!
description:
A plugin that makes Kingdom Hearts UI stuff, such as a health bar for the player.
If you have any questions, issues or suggestions, please post an issue in the github or ping me in the Discord!

name: OOF!
author: Frogworks Interactive
punchline: Play OOF! on fall and/or death. The Only Plugin You Need!
description:
i love roblox!!!

whimsical and magical features...
- when other ppl die
- custom mp3
- instant access to the hour long documentary on oof by hbomberguy

name: Island Workshop Search
author: img
punchline: Helps highlight relevant workshops items
description:
Search items by splitting search terms with |
Example: papri|shark|ink

Step-by-step search by splitting terms with a comma [ , ]
Example: poti,garn,horn
Will search for 'poti' first, then after adding and reopening window, will search for 'garn'

Or just copy and paste the entire Overseas Casuals Squawkbox recommendations.

Works with every game client language.

name: Glamour Log
author: croizat
punchline: Gotta collect 'em all
description: A log for all your glamours and other glam-related tweaks

name: Stylist
author: NightmareXIV
punchline: Gear manager
description: Gear manager that will watch your gearset for possible upgrades and upgrade them via single command.

name: Explorer's Icebox
author: Ice
punchline: What if, we held hands underneath the quartz mountain.
description:
A little helper that lets you level up, or gather all the materials on Island Sanctary. Requires Navmesh & Visland.
Pop open a cold one while the tedious parts of exploration is handled by your good friend cousin robby

name: Burning Down the House
author: LeonBlade
punchline: House decorating made easy!
description: Move around housing items with coordinates and allows you to place anywhere.

name: Hybrid Camera
author: Drahsid
punchline: Legacy and standard movement in one! Move freely!
description: Hybrid camera/movement mode! Move freely!

name: Teamcraft List Maker
author: Aida Enna
punchline: Adds a new menu when right clicking items that lets you easily add/remove items to a list and then export it to Teamcraft
description:
No more alt tabbing, no more writing down names of items, just add and export!

This plugin is not created by Teamcraft staff and they are not responsible for it. To report issues or request new features, please click the globe icon and submit them using the issues tab.

(Logo used with permission from Teamcraft owner)

name: Diadem Calculator
author: Infi, mudcrab2142
punchline: Yet another useful calculator~
description: Calculates your current sessions points and scrip reward

name: Hit it, Joe! (Formerly TF2-ish Critical Hits Plugin)
author: Berna, kai, Kiri
punchline: Configure sounds for critical and direct hits, plus some countdown music.
description:
* Set sounds and flavor text to be played/shown whenever you deal direct or critical damage or heal.
* Set sounds to be played when a countdown is in progress.
* Use different configurations by job.
* Use the game's SFX or your own custom WAV or MP3 files.

name: Collector's Anxiety
author: foophoof
punchline: Hey guys, Famous YouTuber here. Do you ever get Collector's Anxiety?
description: Collector's Anxiety helps completionists or players with a hobby for collecting in-game things keep track of what they do or don't have in an easy-to-use checklist format. Data is loaded live from the game, so collection statuses are updated in real-time.

name: Dropbox
author: kawaii
punchline: Your personal vending machine.
description: Your personal vending machine.

name: Audible Character Status
author: Gotest
punchline: You like annoying low HP sounds? This is great for you!
description:
Plays a sound for certain statuses of the player. Such as low HP or MP.
You will need to provide your own sound files.

name: Hyperborea
author: kawaii, NightmareXIV
punchline: What if we GPosed in the Mordion Gaol?
description: Load and explore any zone in relative safety, mainly for taking GPoses in now inaccessible locations.

name: Allagan Item Search
author: Critical_Impact
punchline: Trying to find that item you don't know the name of? Maybe Allagan Item Search can help.
description: Allagan Item Search is a dalamud plugin designed to help you search and filter all the items available in the game.

name: Tilted
author: Meoiswa
punchline: Tilt the camera, not yourself.
description: Automatically adjusts the Third Person Camera Angle/Distance given certain conditions.

name: AutoMountBgm
author: VariableVixen
punchline: Automatically control mount BGM for individual mounts!
description: Some mounts have really cool BGM tracks (Cruise Chaser FTW) while others are almost sickening in how much you hear them. It's annoying to keep needing to use /mountbgm, but now you won't have to - just let the plugin do it for you!

name: Vera's Integrated World Improvements
author: vera.lyn
punchline: Vera's Integrated World Improvements
description: A collection of plugins-turned-modules, QoL improvements, and Automation features.

name: Better borderless window mode
author: veyn, sourpuh
punchline: Make borderless window mode work well with aero shortcuts
description: Borderless window can now be properly minimized (by clicking on taskbar or by win+down shortcut); when moved between monitors (win+shift+left/right), resolution is updated automatically.

name: Combat Cursor Containment
author: Cytraen
punchline: Keep your mouse cursor contained during combat!
description: Automatically changes the 'limit mouse operation to game window' setting when entering/exiting combat.

name: HUDUnlimited
author: MidoriKami
punchline: Total control of your User Interface
description: Allows you to modify any and all individual elements of the user interface to allow you to customize it however you wish

name: Remote Party Finder Uploader
author: 086, Anna
punchline: Crowdsourced PF website (upload PF listings to xivpf.com)
description: Uploads the PF listings you retrieve to the crowdsourced Remote Party Finder website (https://xivpf.com/).

name: Stanley Parable XIV
author: rekyuu, gaypotatoemma
punchline: Witty commentary to the brilliant things you do.
description: Check /narrator for full options or use /narratorvolume to set volume manually.

name: StackSellPrice
author: Infi, VariableVixen
punchline: Because multiplication is hard.
description: Shows the vendor sell price for the full stack of an item on the tooltip

pick.note: Shows a full stack's vendor sell price on the tooltip instead of just one unit, so you don't have to do the multiplication yourself before deciding to vendor a pile of materials. In the default plugin repo

name: Memory Marker
author: MidoriKami, ash
punchline: Simple Waymark Management with Renaming Features
description:
Ever forget which waymark slot holds your pre-fight positions? Which waymarks are for pugs and not your static?
Worry not! MemoryMarker has your back!

Loads and Saves waymarks when changing zones. Allows you to rename presets in the waymark window.

name: Aether Compass
author: Cytraen, yomishino
punchline: Compasses that detect and mark certain nearby objects/NPCs
description:
This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

Currently detects:
- Aether Currents
- Eureka Elementals (by apetih)
- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
- Gathering Points
- [Experimental] Island Sanctuary Gathering Objects and Animals
- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost

name: Gearsetter
author: vera.lyn
punchline: Find gear upgrades
description: Browse through all gear pieces available for each class/job and show possible upgrades

name: Chat Proximity
author: iv230
punchline: Know how far they talk from.
description: This plugin will change message in the chat within the "say" channel (or other ranged channels), darkening people when they're far from you.

name: Fantasy Player
author: Critical-Impact
punchline: Like you'd ever be sick of the in game music right?
description:
Control Spotify playback from within FFX|V
Use the button below to open settings or use the '/pfp settings' command.
Originally by BiscuitUmU
Localization by Dormanil

name: Resizable HUD
author: Drahsid
punchline: Move and scale vanilla hud elements to your liking!
description: Allows you to more freely and precisely scale and position HUD elements.

name: AutoTimer
author: Aly
punchline: Auto-Attack Timer Bar.
description: Auto-Attack Timer Bar based on the Triggernometry trigger by aya liz.

name: Minesweeper
author: hunter2_
punchline: Classic puzzle game.
description:
Logic puzzle in which you find and flag hidden mines.

Left click to uncover a square, right click to place a flag.
The game ends when all safe squares have been uncovered.
Click the smiley face to start a new game.

name: Pet Scale
author: Kurochi
punchline: Customize pet scale
description: Adjust the scale of your own pets and other player's pets, independent of each other.

name: NICE Damage Flyouts
author: athene
punchline: Adds the message NICE to your damage flyout when you get a hit ending in 69.
description: Adds the message NICE to your damage flyout when you get a hit ending in 69. Also 67, optionally. Also, your own custom numbers now.

name: FFXIV RP Event Calendar
author: erroch
punchline: Want to know what's going on in roleplay today?
description: An in game portal to the FFXIV RP Event Calendar (https://ffxiv-rp.org). Use /events to bring up the list of roleplay events happening this week.

name: WOLdo
author: Haplo064, maintained by Franz
punchline: Making it easier to know where you are.
description: Movable text overlay of the current location name. Please consider migrationg to WhereAmIAgain, which is actively maintained and has more features.

name: QuestTracker
author: isaiahcat, keifufu
punchline: For the quest completionist
description: Easily track quest completion

name: Duty Tracker
author: Infi, X'pahtalo
punchline: Track some duty info.
description: Track some duty info. /dt open the menu

name: Lights, Camera, Action!
author: NeNeppie
punchline: Save and load unlimited camera and lighting presets in Group Pose
description: This plugin lets you save unlimited camera & lighting configurations/presets in Group Pose at a time, vastly improving over the vanilla feature which lets you save only one of each.

name: Bartender
author: Rül Hölos
punchline: Save and load hotbars into profiles, re-use them later, profit.
description: Save and load hotbars with macros and/or chat commands. We all need more than 10 hotbars, well now we do have those.

name: Fast Job Switcher
author: Meoiswa
punchline: Always five* keystrokes away from any job
description: Enables the player to switch jobs using their three letter acronyms as commands. (*: five or more)

name: Target Lines
author: Drahsid
punchline: Customizable target lines
description: Customizable target lines

name: Item Use
author: PunishedPineapple
punchline: Easily see common item uses.
description: Displays indicators in the item help popup for when an item is used by leves, GC dailies, etc. to help you decide what is worth keeping, selling, or taking as a reward.

name: StatusTimers
author: Zeffuro
punchline: Before StatusTimers, my buffs/debuffs were a mystery. Now, it's a well-organized history!
description: StatusTimers provides clear, customizable bars for tracking your crucial buffs and debuffs. It helps you keep an eye on active effects, their remaining durations, and stacks, allowing you to optimize your gameplay without constantly staring at your tiny icons.

name: BilingualTooltips
author: Elypha
punchline: In case the WoL speaks more than one language
description:
Yes, we have tooltips displayed in two languages now. You paid SE for 4 languages so make very good use of it.

- Interested in localised item descriptions in different languages?
- Got fed up of transliterated カタカナ and would rather read just the original words?

We've got you! See plugin config to customise your own experience.

name: Better in Blue
author: NotNite, harbingerftw
punchline: Infinite Blue Mage spell loadouts.
description: Allows you to save, load, and share infinite Blue Mage spell loadouts and hotbars.

name: Prioritizer
author: NightmareXIV
punchline: Prioritizer sets game's priority to high while crafting.
description: Prioritizer sets game's priority to high while crafting. No more failed crafts due to random lags while game is minimized.

name: AutoMammet
author: Rietty
punchline: Provides an easy copy and pastable CSV format you can use for island sanctuary spreadsheets.
description: Provides an easy copy and pastable CSV format you can use for island sanctuary spreadsheets. Provides options to export the popularity, future popularity and the current cycle's supply and demand shift values. Both as words and as numbers on a scale of -2 to 2. This plugin does not provide any calculations for Island Sanctuary, merely an export option for your ingame data. Information is exported to your clipboard, so you can paste into any other program.

name: BatteryGauge
author: Kaz Wolfe
punchline: Keep track of your FFXIV device's battery.
description:
Hey, you! Yes, you! Do you play FFXIV on your laptop or Steam Deck? Or are you so addicted to FFXIV that you have a UPS on your desktop just so you can keep playing through power outages? Then this is the plugin for you!

BatteryGauge adds a battery indicator to your server info bar showing your current battery percentage and expected remaining lifespan (as reported by Windows).

name: Better Housing
author: Sevii
punchline: Furniture selection that actually works properly
description: An improved housing experience. Furniture selection based on what you see, keybinds to switch modes and toggle counter and snap.

name: CashFlow
author: NightmareXIV, Asuna, Klia
punchline: CashFlow is a plugin that will log your trades, sales and purchases.
description: CashFlow is a plugin that will log your trades, sales and purchases.

name: Marketbuddy

name: LootView

punchline: See every item you and your party pick up, as it drops.
description:
LootView is a live loot tracker for you and your party, with a permanent history and statistics behind it.

WHAT YOU GET

Works with every game language: English, Japanese, German and French.

- Live overlay listing every drop with its icon, rarity, quantity, who received it and how long ago.
- Estimated market value of your haul, priced for your home world through Universalis.
- Currency drawer beside the overlay with every currency you hold, its cap and the weekly tomestone limit.
- A banner on screen when another player commends you.
- Need/Greed panel that appears while rolls are open: time left on every item, each Need, Greed and Pass, who is still deciding, and the winner. Roll Need, Greed or Pass right from the panel, with the game's own loot window kept out of the way.
- Collectibles you already have (minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards, emotes, hairstyles, portrait frames) are marked on their icon.
- Detailed item tooltips with item level, jobs, stats, bonuses, materia slots and market price.
- Loot tables for dungeons, trials and raids - the duty you are in, or any duty you search for.
- Searchable history you can filter by item name, rarity, zone, high quality and owner.
- Statistics: rarity breakdown, top zones, daily and hourly activity, play streaks and period-over-period comparisons.
- Duty tracker recording your runs, clear times, items per run and personal bests.
- Export to JSON or CSV whenever you want.

GETTING STARTED

Type /lv to open the tracker and /lv config for settings. You can also open it from the server info bar.
Right-click any item to try it on, look it up, copy its name or blacklist it.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PRIVACY

Your history is stored locally in your Dalamud configuration folder and is never uploaded. Market prices are looked up from universalis.app and loot tables from garlandtools.org; both requests send only an item or duty ID. Price lookups can be turned off in the settings.

name: It's Up
author: Juan Medina
punchline: Yes. Still up. Press it.
description:
Doing your rotation is hard enough without having to stare at your hotbars. This plugin helps you know exactly when an ability you actually care about is back up.

We don't want to clutter your screen with a massive status board. This won't show you everything that's currently available—instead, it stays completely empty until you use an ability in combat. Once you spend it and it comes off cooldown, the icon pops up to remind you. Press it, and it's gone again.

Because it only reminds you about things you've already used, it won't spam your screen before a pull. And for abilities with charges, it only pings when you go from 0 to 1—if you're sitting on a charge, it stays out of your way since you can already press it.

It's perfect for those key rotational abilities you really don't want to drift. You can also configure each ability so the reminder stays on screen until you press it, or quietly disappears after a few seconds.

name: I Am Ready

description:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter.

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns.
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool

HitSpark replaces Final Fantasy XIV's combat text with its own renderer: better fonts, tuned motion and real impact on critical hits.

WHAT YOU GET

- Every kind of combat text redrawn: damage dealt and taken, healing, misses and evades, status effects, experience, crafting and loot.
- Eight built-in presets, each a complete look: Classic+, Heroic, Tally, Onslaught, Elemental, Grim, Minimal and Retro.

- A style editor for every category with a live preview, and presets you can share as a short code.

GETTING STARTED

Type /hitspark (or /hs) to open the settings and pick a preset. /hitspark test plays sample numbers on you and your target, even out of combat.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you.

PLAYS BY THE RULES

HitSpark is purely cosmetic: it only redraws text the game already shows you and follows the game's own flying text and pop-up text options. If a game update breaks it, the game's own numbers come back on their own. Settings and presets are stored locally and nothing is ever sent anywhere.

name: Total Character Level
author: anqied
punchline: Ever wanted to know how many levels you have across all your jobs?
description: Adds numbers to the Classes/Jobs panel showing the sum of the levels of all your jobs.

name: Quest Text Recolor
author: ScareCrowLegion
punchline: Customize quest objective text and popup layout.
description: Customize FFXIV's center-screen quest objective popup with custom text colors, font size, position, scale, presets, and optional Penumbra-based textures.

name: Saru
author: Valenth Siveria
punchline: JavaScript automation scripts and collected object information.
description: /saru opens the Saru workspace. /saru start <scriptname> starts a script and /saru stop stops all running scripts.

name: No Quest Icons
author: Grimmortal Dread
punchline: Hides every quest icon above NPC nameplates, sortable by type, with peek and toggle hotkeys.
description: Hides every quest icon above NPC nameplates. Icons are sortable and hideable by quest type (Main Scenario, Side Quest, Guildleve, Class/Job Quest, and more), with common types pre-categorized. Includes a peek key to reveal hidden icons on demand and a separate toggle key to switch the whole plugin on/off.

name: Bardic Memory
author: OOF Games
punchline: Guess the tune from FFXIV's orchestrion library
description:
A music guessing game built on the game's own orchestrion library. Each round plays a split second of a random track: name it for six points, or stretch the clip until you know the tune.

ゲーム内のオーケストリオン譜のライブラリーを使った曲当てゲームです。各ラウンドではランダムな曲がほんの一瞬だけ流れます。曲名を当てれば6ポイント、分からなければ曲が分かるまで再生時間を延ばせます。

Ein Musikratespiel auf Basis der spieleigenen Orchestrion-Bibliothek. In jeder Runde erklingt nur ein Sekundenbruchteil eines zufälligen Stücks: Nenne es für sechs Punkte oder verlängere den Ausschnitt, bis du die Melodie erkennst.

Un jeu de devinettes musicales fondé sur la bibliothèque d'orchestrion du jeu. Chaque manche ne joue qu'une fraction de seconde d'un morceau au hasard : nommez-le pour six points, ou allongez l'extrait jusqu'à reconnaître la mélodie.

name: Gubal
author: Juan Medina
punchline: Open web pages, wikis, and Lodestone articles in your browser directly from your chat bar.
description:
Inspired by the /wiki command from Guild Wars 2, Gubal lets you open web pages in your browser straight from the in-game chat bar. Named after the Great Gubal Library, just type a slash command followed by what you're looking for to jump directly to specific guides, item pages, and articles in your default browser.

Commands and Examples:

/wiki [query] - Search the FFXIV Console Games Wiki (opens in browser):
- /wiki great gubal library (opens The Great Gubal Library dungeon guide)
- /wiki sightseeing log (opens the Sightseeing Log guide)
- /wiki relic weapons (opens the Relic Weapon progression guide)
- /wiki blue mage spells (opens the Blue Mage spell list)

/lodestone [query] - Search the official Lodestone (opens in browser):
- /lodestone patch 7.56 (opens the Patch 7.56 notes directly)
- /lodestone maintenance (opens latest server maintenance notices)
- /lodestone eorzea database excalibur (opens official item details)
- /lodestone community finder (opens the Community Finder)

/gubal - Open the configuration window to add, edit, or customize search commands with the {text} placeholder.

name: Paggles
author: InvoxiPlayGames
punchline: My Final Fantasy XIV says paggles right next to the time, what does this mean?
description: Changes the time in the Server Bar to use the system locale for AM/PM designation.

name: FateLimit
author: GitHixy
punchline: See the edge of every FATE, and know before you step out of it.
description:
FateLimit draws the border of FATE areas right in the world, so you always know where the fight ends and never lose your level sync by wandering out.

WHAT YOU GET

- Five border styles made to sit in Eorzea: Aether ring, Barrier wall, Marching dashes, Crystal runes and FATE ember.
- Two ways to show them: always, or only when you get close to the edge of the FATE you're in.
- A warning colour that creeps in as you near the edge, an on-screen banner with the distance left and a marker on the closest point of the border.
- Borders that follow the ground over hills and slopes instead of floating through them.
- Colour, thickness, height, spacing, glow and animation for every style, with a live preview in the settings.

GETTING STARTED

Type /fatelimit (or /fl) to open the settings. /fatelimit test places a practice FATE around you so you can try every style without waiting for a real one.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you, or come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PLAYS BY THE RULES

FateLimit is purely visual: it only reads where FATEs are, which the game already shows on your map, and draws over the screen. It never moves your character or sends anything to the game. Settings are stored locally and nothing is ever uploaded.

name: Tataru Link
author: DN5S
punchline: Tataru Punch
description: Chat Translator

name: Flash When Cutscene Done
author: Sub07
punchline: Flash the game in taskbar when a cutscene ends and the game is unfocused.
description: Flash the game in taskbar when a cutscene ends and the game is unfocused.

name: Gearset Reminder
author: Gid
punchline: Reminds you to switch gearsets when entering duties.
description: Configure duties to warn you to the correct gearset on entry.

name: Custom Loading Screens
author: Abyeon
punchline: Your loading screens, your way!
description: Replaces loading screen imagery with custom defined images.

name: Mount Binder
author: Rül Hölos
punchline: Bind one or multiple keys to one or multiple mounts!
description: Use a keyboard key to call your mounts. This way, you don't waste precious hotbar slots!

name: XIV Remote Chat
author: chika
punchline: Remote control of your chat.
description: Allows you to control any instance of FF connected to chat or send commands.

name: S Rank Assistant
author: The Redheaded Witch
punchline: I spent hours wokring hard coding so I could be lazy! Wouldn't you?'
description: Auto counter for S Rank Summoning! Counts kills, gathering attempts, and even discarding items. Tracker is per zone so you can keep track of multiple locations at once. Even tracks the kills of others.

name: Shrinkage
author: mikelosx
punchline: Shrinks characters based on their Health!
description:
This plugin will shrink and grow characters based on how much health they have, affects you and your party

/shrinkage to open the config window.

name: Wahbuttons
author: wah
punchline: Floating button windows that run any chat command.
description: Floating button windows that run any chat command. Lay buttons out in a column, a row or a grid, lock a window in place, make it see-through, and toggle it with /wahbuttons.

name: SAMMI Webhook Plugin
author: Hattu
punchline: OBS automation based on game events via SAMMI webhooks
description:
Sends game data SAMMI via webhook, allowing users to automate OBS actions such as playing effects, transitions, sounds, etc. based on in-game events.
Requires SAMMI and OBS to function. See https://sammi.solutions or the plugin's readme on GitHub.
/psammi to configure.

name: rec-cue
author: Miu-B
punchline: Recording activity indicator.
description: A Dalamud plugin that monitors a configurable folder for recording file activity and shows an in-game [Rec] indicator when capture is likely active. Use /reccue to configure.

name: ChestDiff
author: YuuNoce
punchline: Summarize Free Company chest history by item and player.
description:
ChestDiff reads the visible Free Company chest history, filters rows after a configured date/time, and summarizes deposits and withdrawals by item and player. It only processes rows available from the in-game Free Company Chest Log.

Commands:
/chestdiff - Open ChestDiff.
/chestdiff export - Export a summary CSV.
/chestdiff dump - Export diagnostic raw chest log text to CSV.
/chestdiff help - Show command help.

name: MeowNET
author: kawaii
punchline: Multiboxing and IPC passthru, powered by cats.
description: MeowNET operates as a virtual party/lobby system to orchestrate many Dalamud plugins together and provide a platform for multiboxers.

name: Throw Crap Out
author: Valenth Siveria
punchline: Don't carry your old stuff around
description:
Wiht ThrowCrapOut (/tco) you can sort, clear out and free your Space in your Armoury. It allows you to sort your Armoury and pull out Gear not assigned to a Gearset.

Features:
- Sort = Just sorts your Gear in your Armoury by Item Level descending.
- Split = Basically like Sort, but moving Non-Gearset Gear to the end Slots of each Category.
- Clear = Pulls out your Non-Gearset Gear out of your Armoury to your Inventory.

Allows to clear out one category by another (default) or just taking the highest Item Level of Non-Gearset Gear one after another across the Categories to your Inventory.

Define a limit of free Inventory Space to keep, if you have way too much old gear stuff in your Armoury.

Define, which Categories should be handled, and which not.

Visual feedback for the sorting. Never guess anymore, how unsorted and chaotic your Armoury maybe looks like. TCO will take care of it.

Commands:

- /tco
- /tco settings
- /tco sort
- /tco split
- /tco clear

Language support for the 4 main Languages.

name: Train Conductor
author: The Redheaded Witch
punchline: Choo Choo
description:
Import your data from Turtle, then manage everything in the GUI!

There is a known bug with the dragging of List of monsters. Dragging works, but there is a graphical glitch while dragging. It is completely cosmetic but annoying. The arrows work without issue. I will work on fixing this.

name: GatheringPathRenderer
author: alydev
punchline: [Questionable dev plugin]: Renders gathering location.
description: [Questionable dev plugin]: Renders gathering location using Pictomancy.

author: Ottermandias

description: Adds functionality to change and store appearance of players, customization and equip. Requires Penumbra to be installed and activated to work. Can also add preview options to the Changed Items tab for Penumbra.

pick.note: Changes your character's outside appearance using Penumbra mods, what Glamaholic plates apply through. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory

name: Penumbra
author: Ottermandias, Nylfae, Adam, Wintermute
punchline: Runtime mod loader and manager.
description: Runtime mod loader and manager.

pick.note: Runtime mod loader, applies texture/model mods without touching game files. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory

name: Customize+
author: Risa and Contributors
punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
description: A plugin that allows you to customize your character beyond FFXIV limitations by directly editing bone parameters.
